say:1:1012422001:1.text: Prayer Day is coming! As a rule, we need to dance for the Deer Spirit!
say:1:1012422001:1.source_cn: 祈福日马上到了，按照规矩，我们要在圣丘跳舞，为鹿灵助兴！

say:2:1012422002:1.text: <style="highlight">One of our dancers</style> is missing! Her friend asked her to go pick flowers, but she never returned! I can't find her anywhere!

say:3:1012422003:1.text: If the prayer dance doesn't happen, the ceremony won't be held on time! What should we do...?
say:3:1012422003:1.source_cn: 祈福舞跳不成，祈福仪式就不能按时举办了！这可怎么办……

say:4:1012422004:1.text: Magister! If Prayer Day is postponed, we'll have to stay in Ivoryshade until the next full moon!
say:4:1012422004:1.source_cn: 主人！如果祈福日延期，我们就要在月影乡待到下一次满月了！
say:4:1012422004:1.male: Magister! If Prayer Day is postponed, we'll have to stay in Ivoryshade until the next full moon!
